subject: Judge: review blocking-dep context-seed (gate-transparent) — self-learn-judge, single-attempt
description: self-learn-judge SINGLE-ATTEMPT review against the impl attempt branch. Rubric + gates: (1) seed goes through overlayStore.addEdge (the unified writer), in the autowire/ingestNode path — NOT suggest_links; (2) edges are LOW-WEIGHT + by:'autowire-blockdep' + judged:false (enter the judge pipeline, don't flood retrieval); (3) GATE-TRANSPARENT — a gate dep is never a seed endpoint; the walk passes THROUGH to the real upstream node, bounded; (4) bounded 1-hop (no transitive blocked-by walk); (5) idempotent + tests cover the gate-skip case. APPROVE → merge to main; KICK BACK → set_status failed + wired record_decision. Never force-merge.
